oftlaunch: This is a first for our branch. O F T kits are now in the Log Book, and every single kit gets its own tracking number, from the moment it's logged, all the way to the collation branch.
Here's how it works. Collect the sample from your client, open the Log Book, and choose O F T Kit.
Pick your client and the policy, straight from Salesforce. One kit per line.
Press log, and your tracking number appears. R R B, O F T, today's date, then the kit's own number. Write it on the kit.
Hand the kit to sales support. They sign for it on their phone, and you get an e-mail the moment they do.
Sales support builds one transmittal, and chooses this quarter's collation branch. Every kit, every number, on one page.
Need to find a kit? Search the number, the policy, or your client's name, and see exactly where it is.
A first for our branch. From today, every O F T kit goes through the Log Book. Ricky Rampersad branch dot com, slash log book.
